name: democratic-republic-of-congo-drc-transport-infrastructures-openstreetmap-export
notes:
République démocratique du Congo (RDC), Transport

Points + Lines + Polygons  OSM Features Interactive Online Map - 

First Column Thematic Variable shows line content : Airport facility, Airport runway, Helipad, Harbour, Shipyard, Rail line, Rail yard, Transport Station & Stop, Ferry Terminal, Transport Ferry Route, Transport Route Itinaries
 
[Aeroways (Airports)](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key%3Aaeroway)
[Railways](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:railway)
[Aerialways](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:aerialway)
[Railway, Tram Routes](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Relation:route)

Variables : 
name, name:en, name:fr, operator, operator:type, natural, aerialway, aerodrome, aeroway, runway, taxiway, apron, helipad, heliport, iata, icao, public_transport, rail, railway, ref, route, network, station, service, shelter, harbor, bus, highway, bridge, tunnel, landuse, surface, building, building:levels, building:material, building:condition, building:status, building:min_level, address, addr:housenumber, addr:street, addr:city, layer, private, source_ref, source, source:name, source:date, source:data, source_ref:1, survey:date, timezone, toilets, type, voltage, weelchair, wikidata, wikipedia

OSM Filter

    OSM features :
    thematic in (
    'Rail yard',
    'Rail line',
    'Transport Route Itinary',
    'Helipad', 'Airport Runway',
    'Airport Facility',
    'Shipyard', 'Ferry Terminal',
    'Transport Station, Stop')
